title: Relay recovery, retirement and per-token cutoff
description: Gaps from guides alignment: relay restored from backup cannot ask COs to resend registrations; no relay retirement signal to COs; operator cannot cut off a single token (abuse); blobs live only at the uploading relay (§10.3.5 understates). Also: no fixed {prov} base path; did:webvh witness parameter shape in o365 follows a reading of did:webvh v1.0 not checked against spec text.
